name: SkipClicks
author: Oddisz
description: Cuts the extra clicks out of planet surveys, salvage and battle loot. Adds a one-click Fast survey option to unsurveyed planets, skips the Assess and Explore step and the accident report when salvaging, and (with PatchLib installed) skips the Continue after ship recovery so the loot opens right away. Every skip can be turned off in the LunaLib settings.
